conventions.notation: H = I - (1/n) 1 1^T. <A, B> is the Frobenius inner product. K_t is the raw probe kernel and Kc_t = H K_t H. k_t = Kc_t / ||Kc_t||_F is the unit centred kernel. Y is the one-hot probe labels, G = H Y Y^T H and g = G / ||G||_F. g_perp is the part of g orthogonal to k_0, scaled to unit length. d_t = k_t - k_0 is the change of the unit kernel.
conventions.kernel: The sum-over-logits kernel of RepoducedCode.compute_entk in mode trace. K_ij is the sum over the p outputs of the inner product of the parameter gradients of that output at probe points i and j.
conventions.centring: Every term, share and eigenvector uses the centred kernel H K H, following Cortes, Mohri and Rostamizadeh (2012), Lemma 1, and the report's Kernel metrics section.
conventions.probe: The mixed probe of the report's Kernel metrics section, as ntk_lib.select_probe takes it. At p = 23 and a training fraction of 0.9 it holds 203 training pairs followed by all 53 test pairs.
conventions.precision: torch computes the kernel in float32. Everything derived from it here is computed in float64 from that float32 kernel.
conventions.matching: A linear assignment on minus the absolute overlaps with the previous checkpoint's top 88 eigenvectors, by scipy.optimize.linear_sum_assignment. An assigned overlap below 0.5 marks a new arrival.
conventions.sign: Fixed by continuity, so that each matched eigenvector has a positive inner product with its predecessor. A vector with no predecessor has its largest entry in absolute value made positive.
conventions.label_subspace: The column space of H Y. It has dimension p - 1.
conventions.subspaces: The centred functions on the probe points of (a + b) mod p, (a - b) mod p, a, and b, in that order. Each has dimension p - 1.
conventions.checkpoints: Step 0, every 250 steps, and 60 log-spaced steps from 1 to the run length, rounded to integers. Rounding merges some of the smallest ones.

step.source: docs/report.tex, Kernel metrics section, for the log-spaced grid

K.meaning: The raw probe kernel, in float32 as torch computed it.

f_probe.meaning: The centred and rescaled predictor on the probe set.
f_probe.source: ntk_lib.train_run, which follows Kumar et al. (2024), Appendix 8.1, Equation 7

train_loss.formula: Copied from the history row at the checkpoint.

test_loss.formula: Copied from the history row at the checkpoint.

train_acc.formula: Copied from the history row at the checkpoint.

test_acc.formula: Copied from the history row at the checkpoint.

param_dist.formula: Copied from the history row at the checkpoint.

weight_norm.formula: Copied from the history row at the checkpoint.

yKy.meaning: y^T K^+ y on the probe set, summed over the label columns.
yKy.formula: Copied from the history row at the checkpoint.

K_norm_centred.meaning: The Frobenius norm of the centred kernel.
K_norm_centred.source: Cortes, Mohri and Rostamizadeh (2012), Lemma 1, for H K H

inner_K0.meaning: Inner product of the centred kernel with the centred kernel at step 0.

inner_G.meaning: Inner product of the centred kernel with the centred target Gram matrix.

S.meaning: The scale term on the centred kernel. It matches the history field S_c.

R.meaning: The rotation term on the centred kernel. It matches the history field R_c.

A.meaning: The centred alignment. It matches the history field A_t.
A.source: Cortes, Mohri and Rostamizadeh (2012), Definition 4; docs/report.tex, Kernel metrics section

A_uncentred.meaning: The alignment without centring. It matches the history field A_u.

D.meaning: The movement statistic on the centred kernel.
D.source: docs/report.tex, Equation eq:decomp, applied to the centred kernel

exp2S_term.meaning: The first piece of Equation eq:decomp. D^2 = exp2S_term + 1 - cross_term.
exp2S_term.source: docs/report.tex, Equation eq:decomp, the group's own algebra

cross_term.meaning: The last piece of Equation eq:decomp.
cross_term.source: docs/report.tex, Equation eq:decomp, the group's own algebra

gamma.meaning: The aim, the cosine between the part of k_t orthogonal to k_0 and g_perp. NaN at step 0, where the kernel has not moved.
gamma.formula: <v_t, g_perp> / ||v_t||_F with v_t = k_t - <k_t, k_0> k_0
gamma.source: term_dependence.py docstring, the group's own algebra

share_k0.meaning: The share of ||d_t||^2 along k_0. NaN at step 0.

share_gperp.meaning: The share of ||d_t||^2 along g_perp. NaN at step 0.

share_residual.meaning: The share of ||d_t||^2 orthogonal to both k_0 and g_perp. The three shares sum to one. NaN at step 0.
share_residual.formula: ||d_t - <d_t, k_0> k_0 - <d_t, g_perp> g_perp||^2 / ||d_t||^2, which equals (1 - gamma^2) (1 - R / 2)

eigvals.meaning: All eigenvalues of the centred kernel, largest first.

eigvecs_topk.meaning: The eigenvectors of the top_k largest eigenvalues, as columns in eigenvalue order at each checkpoint, with signs fixed as conventions.sign says.

match_index.meaning: The column at the previous checkpoint that each column continues. Minus one for a new arrival and at step 0.

overlap_prev.meaning: The absolute inner product with the assigned column at the previous checkpoint. It is kept for new arrivals too, where it is below the threshold. NaN at step 0.

origin_index.meaning: The column at step 0 that the chain of matches leads back to. Minus one if the chain passes through a new arrival. This array is an addition to the plan.

overlap_zero.meaning: The absolute inner product with the step 0 column that origin_index names. NaN where origin_index is minus one.

principal_angles_zero.meaning: Principal angles in radians between the span of the top eigenvectors and the same span at step 0, smallest first.
principal_angles_zero.formula: arccos of the singular values of V_t^T V_0

principal_angles_label.meaning: Principal angles in radians between the span of the top eigenvectors and the label subspace, smallest first.
principal_angles_label.formula: arccos of the singular values of V_t^T Q with Q a basis of H Y

subspace_energy.meaning: For each top eigenvector, the share of its squared length in each of the four subspaces of conventions.subspaces. The projection is by least squares, because the probe set is a subset of the pairs and the indicator functions are not orthogonal on it. The four shares need not sum to one.
subspace_energy.formula: ||Q_s^T u||^2 with Q_s an orthonormal basis of subspace s

torus_K_unit.meaning: The torus average of the unit centred kernel.

torus_change.meaning: The torus average of the change of the unit centred kernel since step 0.

torus_residual.meaning: The torus average of the part of d_t that share_residual measures. It is not divided by its length.

probe_a.meaning: The first number a of each probe pair. Stored once.

probe_b.meaning: The second number b of each probe pair. The label of probe point i is (a_i + b_i) mod p. Stored once.

probe_is_test.meaning: True at the probe pairs that are test pairs. Stored once.

G_norm.meaning: The norm of the centred target Gram matrix. Stored once.

A_0.meaning: The centred alignment at step 0. Stored once.
